reviews.comment: She is definitely not the best at teaching, but her tests were very easy if you just went to the class before the exam. She goes through her slides and tells you exactly what will be on the test. She is very nice and likes giving out extra credit as well.

Be prepared to go to class and get more confused than when you walked in. Lecture heavy, except the lectures don't cover what's actually on the test. She stumbled over her words the entire class and going to lecture was miserable. Attendance was taken 2 times and she did extra credit for participation. Tests were confusing.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are super hard to follow and professor stumbles over her words. She literally stands in front of the whiteboard when writing and writes super small so bring binoculars. Tests are worded weird and use terms you've probably never heard. Class is easy but you just have to do all the learning yourself

As the person below me says, this class is may be the most boring one I have ever put myself through. Thank god the exams were extremely free, but I could not get myself to pay attention for over 20% of the lecture. Would study the day before the tests. Not worth an easy A, would much rather take a significantly harder class with a better prof.

Class was wildly boring. I could never pay attention. She cared about students, but lectures were rough. Offered opportunities to come back from bad tests by replacing lowest grades with the final. Content was fine, but something about the presentation was numbing.

Quizzes almost weekly on Canvas. 3 exams including the final exam. The class was curved around 4 points at the end. One 5 minute group presentation. She took attendance maybe 3 times the entire semester. Would do zoom classes sometimes.

super super nice prof, but honestly just cannot teach that well. exams are tricky (not straight from the lectures), and they are only 25 multiple choice. very easy concepts to learn, going to class is pointless.
The worst professor I have had so far in college.

She seems nice but can't teach what so ever. She will show a slide and ask us if we learned the concept in another class and then use that as justification not to teach it herself. When she does teach, I have a hard time understanding what she is saying. I'll ask her a question and then be more confused after she's done explaining.

She is a very nice first-year professor but is not good at teaching. I would avoid her for a few semesters after the date of this post or until she gets good reviews. The class is unbelievably boring and confusing. Also, the course is based 30% on the midterm and 40% on the final exam. Unless you already know a ton about finance do not take.

She was super nice but COULD NOT teach. Her lectures were pointless. I would end up more confused after attending lecture. Ended up reading the textbook and having to teach myself. Didn't know how to answer student questions and sometimes would ignore them. There were some quizzes, but the grades were mostly made up of one midterm and one final.
